claim: Selected records compile into exact reviewable Markdown before release, with source paths, Git revisions, and vendor-neutral references.
sandbox: fresh demo and real workspace; preview selected records before persistence, confirm, and compare preview, release, and download bytes

claim: A released source is flagged as stale after its Git revision changes.
sandbox: fresh demo state; change the sample ADR revision and inspect its existing release

claim: Released context packs download as Markdown with vendor-neutral references.
sandbox: fresh demo state; download the sample release and inspect its bytes

claim: One local Markdown file can be imported into a selected source draft.
sandbox: fresh demo; import the shipped Markdown fixture, save it, select it, and inspect its exact body and path in the draft

claim: Released context packs copy as Markdown with vendor-neutral references.
sandbox: fresh demo; copy the sample release and read the clipboard

claim: Deleting a source does not change a released pack.
sandbox: fresh demo; read released Markdown, delete a cited source, and compare the release bytes

claim: Demo changes stay in an isolated browser session and send requests only to this product.
sandbox: fresh demo; record every request while adding a sample source

claim: Demo records do not enter the real project database.
where: demo banner, landing, privacy page, README
sandbox: create a real workspace, mutate demo data, then prove the real workspace is unchanged and no demo mutation uses a real write endpoint

claim: The demo works offline after its first visit.
where: privacy page, README and demo documentation
sandbox: new browser context; open /demo, wait for its service worker, go offline, and reload

claim: A buyer can restore the team plan by pasting a valid Sociobot license.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; intercept the Sociobot verify endpoint with a valid fixture

claim: A team license stays in the browser and is sent only to Sociobot for verification.
sandbox: fresh browser storage; verify a recorded valid token and inspect storage plus every request containing it

claim: The service stores a one-way workspace-key hash, not the raw key.
sandbox: temporary SQLite database; persist a known key workspace record and assert the stored value is its SHA-256 digest and the raw-key lookup is empty

claim: Real workspace records persist across a restart that uses the same data directory.
sandbox: spawn the shipped binary against a temporary data directory, write a source, restart the binary, and read that source

claim: Repositories are never crawled or indexed automatically; the user adds each approved source.
sandbox: enter through /demo, start a fresh real workspace, record requests, add one explicit source, and assert no repository connector or indexing request exists

claim: The free plan includes one release.
sandbox: enter through /demo, start a fresh real workspace without a license, add one source, preview, and release the first context pack

claim: A verified team license allows more than one release.
sandbox: create the free release, verify a recorded valid license response, then preview and create a second release

claim: A verified team license lets its holder share a workspace key that opens the same workspace for a teammate.
sandbox: add a source, prove sharing is locked, verify a recorded license response, then open the workspace from a fresh browser context using the shared key

claim: The product loads no third-party fonts, scripts, or trackers.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record all requests while opening landing, demo, privacy, and workspace; assert script, stylesheet, font, and tracking requests stay on the product origin

claim: New team checkout is unavailable and no purchase action is shown.
sandbox: fresh landing; assert the unavailable state, no buy link, and an available existing-license recovery dialog
